integrity: Exact all-parameter elementary proof and dependency-free integer exhaustive test for eight bounded parameter tuples; finite tests do not independently certify the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unit-incidence Euclidean realization, uniform distinct-vertex sampling, simple generalized theta graphs with at least three paths of length at least two, at least one of length three or more. The known all-length-two (complete bipartite) uniform-vertex covariance is excluded from novelty. No claims for Gaussian exposure, uniform interior volume, arbitrary edge weights, or exhaustive unindexed priority.
title: A terminal rank-one covariance law for generalized-theta graphical zonotopes
